help:
VidShrink {0}: shrink a video to a size or a quality, without the window.

Usage:
  vidshrink kucult <input> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]
  vidshrink plan <input> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]
  vidshrink izle <folder> --cikti <folder> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]

Commands:
  kucult (shrink)   Encode the input. Progress goes to stderr, the result to stdout.
  plan              Print the plan and the ffmpeg arguments. Nothing is encoded.
  izle (watch)      Shrink every new video in a folder into the output folder. A file is taken
                    once its size and time stay unchanged over two scan intervals - the third scan
                    takes it - and it is not locked for writing. A file that changes while it is shrunk is tried again.
                    Files are noted in .vidshrink-izle.json and not shrunk again after a restart;
                    when the folder is read-only the note goes to the output folder. A failed
                    file is tried once more on the next start; delete the state file to redo all.
                    Ctrl+C stops cleanly.

Options:
  --dil, --lang CODE        Interface language for this run: en | tr. Default: the system language.
  --hedef, --target SIZE    Target size: 25MB, 25, 1.5GB.
  --kalite, --quality N     Target quality score, 1-100. The size is derived from it.
  --kodek, --codec C        auto | h264 | hevc | av1. Default auto.
  --crf N                   Lock the quality value, 0-63. It overrides the plan own CRF.
  --on-ayar, --preset NAME  Lock the encoder preset (slow, veryfast, p5, 8...). The name has to
                            belong to the chosen codec, otherwise the plan drops it.
  --modul, --modulus N      Round scaled edges down to a multiple of this: 2 | 4 | 8 | 16.
                            Default 2. A larger modulus is for old hardware encoders and crops the
                            edge a little more.
  --cikti, --output PATH    Output file. Default <input>_shrunk.mp4 beside the input.
                            izle: the output folder, required.
  --json                    Write the result as JSON on stdout. izle: one object per line (NDJSON).
  --olcumsuz, --no-measure  Skip the probe encodes; plan from the source bitrate.
  --vmaf                    Measure VMAF on the finished file when ffmpeg has libvmaf.
  --hizli, --fast           Prefer the fast hardware path, like the window's GPU box.
  --kes, --cut FROM-TO      Shrink only this range; the target size applies to the range's output.
                            Ends take seconds, clock form (0:10) or frames: --kes 300f-900f.
                            Ends are seconds or clock time: 10-40, 0:10-0:40, 90- (to the end).
                            Chapter markers are dropped in a range encode.
  --bolum, --chapters N     Builds the range from the source's chapter marks: 2 or 2-4. Cannot
                            be given with --kes.
  --tarama, --scan          Prints the source's title inventory and stops; nothing is encoded.
  --baslik, --title N       Picks the title with this number. Default: the first title.
  --ana-icerik, --main-feature
                            Picks the longest title. Cannot be combined with --baslik.
  --aci, --angle N          DVD angle, 1 to 9. Only meaningful for a disc source.
  --asgari-sure, --min-duration SEC
                            Drops titles shorter than this from the inventory.
  --suzgec, --filters SPEC  Picture filters, comma separated: crop=W:H:X:Y, pad=T:B:L:R,
                            denoise=nlmeans|hqdn3d[:light|medium|strong],
                            sharpen=light|medium|strong, deblock, deband, gray, detelecine,
                            rotate=clock|cclock|180|hflip|vflip, deinterlace=auto|on|off,
                            colorspace=bt709|bt601.
  --profil, --profile ID    Applies a profile from the preset library.
                            Flags given by hand override the profile.
                            Lists the library: vidshrink presets
  --kirp, --crop            Detects black bars and crops the rectangle it finds.
                            Given together with --suzgec crop=, the manual value wins.
  --aralik, --interval SEC  izle: seconds between scans, also the settle time. Default 2.
  --bir-kez, --once         izle: stop once the files present are done.
  --gunluk, --log           Prints the diagnostic log: the last runs' command, versions and
                            ffmpeg's last error lines. Paths are reduced to file names.

Exit codes:
  0   Done, size inside the band (or the source was already small enough).
  2   Done, but under the band: quality was saturated, the smaller file was kept.
  3   The target could not be met: the size ceiling was exceeded.
  4   izle --bir-kez: at least one file failed.
  1   Error: ffmpeg missing, unreadable input, encode failure.
  64  Wrong usage.  130  Cancelled with Ctrl+C.
error.bad-quality: Quality must be a number from 1 to 100: {0}
error.bad-chapter: The chapter number is invalid or the source does not have it: {0}
error.chapter-and-cut: --kes and --bolum cannot be given together; both set the cut window.
error.no-chapters: The source has no chapter marks.
error.no-fps: The source frame rate could not be read; the frame form cannot be used.
error.bad-codec: Unknown codec: {0}. Use auto, h264, hevc or av1.
error.bad-crf: CRF must be a number from 0 to 63: {0}
error.bad-preset: Unknown preset: {0}. Use a preset name that belongs to the chosen codec.
error.bad-modulus: The scale modulus must be 2, 4, 8 or 16: {0}
error.bad-profile: Unknown profile: {0}. To see the library: vidshrink presets
error.profile-no-target: The {0} profile has no target size; give --hedef or --kalite.
error.extra-input: Only one input file is accepted: {0}
error.tool-missing: {0} was not found. Put it on PATH or beside VidShrink.
error.same-output: The output path is the input file.
error.no-space: Not enough disk space: about {0} MB is needed.
result.alignment: Alignment: source and test timestamps are {0} ms ({1} frames) apart; frames were matched by index, not by timestamp.
result.under-band: Under the band: quality was saturated and the smaller file was kept.
result.ceiling: The size ceiling was exceeded after {0} attempts; nothing was delivered.
result.ceiling-kept: The size ceiling was exceeded after {0} attempts; the smallest result ({1} MB) was delivered anyway.
error.bad-interval: The interval must be a positive number of seconds: {0}
error.watch-no-folder: No folder to watch was given.
error.watch-no-output: izle needs an output folder: --cikti FOLDER.
error.watch-missing: The folder to watch does not exist: {0}
error.watch-same-output: The output folder must differ from the watched folder, or the outputs would be shrunk again.
watch.corrupt-state: The state file was unreadable; it was kept as {0} and the list starts empty.
watch.waiting: Waiting for the write to finish: {0}
watch.failed: Failed and noted: {0}: {1}. It is tried once more on the next start.
watch.stopped: Watching stopped; the state file is saved.
watch.skipped: Skipped, it is an output of this watch: {0}
watch.collided: Skipped: {0} — its name collides with {1} (letter case only). Rename one of them.
watch.collided.summary: {0} file(s) skipped because of a name collision.
watch.changed: The file changed while it was shrunk; the output was removed and it will be tried again: {0}
watch.state-elsewhere: The watched folder is not writable; the state file is {0}
watch.state-not-saved: The state file could not be written: {0}: {1}. Watching goes on.
gunluk.bos: The log is empty: no run has been recorded yet.
error.bad-title: The title number is invalid or the source does not have it: {0}
error.bad-angle: The angle must be a number from 1 to 9: {0}
error.bad-min-duration: The minimum duration must be a number of seconds: {0}
error.no-titles: The source has no readable title.
error.no-titles-after-min: No title is left after --asgari-sure; lower the limit.
